# CRCibernetica IdeaBoard

> CircuitPython libraries, reference documents and examples for the IdeaBoard, an ESP32-based educational robotics board made in Costa Rica, and the IdeaSense Explorer and SumoBot v2 boards that plug into it. The board has no USB drive: files reach it over the serial REPL.

Read the reference document for the hardware in use before writing code. Start with the IdeaBoard document; add the others only when that hardware is present.

## Reference documents for AI assistants

- [IdeaBoard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/master/skills/ideaboard.md): motors, RGB LED, servos, pins and sensors, Wi-Fi, buzzer. Always read this one.
- [IdeaSense Explorer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/master/skills/ideasense.md): 5x5 LED matrix, buttons, temperature/humidity, light, accelerometer/gyro.
- [SumoBot v2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/master/skills/sumobotv2.md): infrared floor sensors, colour sensor, IMU, motors.
- [Other libraries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/master/skills/libraries.md): finding, copying and testing a CircuitPython library for any other sensor or module.

## Tools

- [ibserial.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/master/tools/ibserial.py): command-line program to list, copy and run files on the board over USB serial. Run with no arguments for usage.

## Examples

- [examples/](https://github.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/tree/master/examples): working scripts for the IdeaBoard, with `ideasense/`, `sumobot/` (SumoBot v1) and `sumobotv2/` subfolders.
- [lib/](https://github.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/tree/master/lib): the board libraries as shipped.
- [root/](https://github.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/tree/master/root): `boot.py`, `code.py` and `settings.toml` as they ship in the board's root folder.

## Optional

- [Wiki](https://github.com/CRCibernetica/circuitpython-ideaboard/wiki): human-facing documentation. Pinouts and jumper settings, IdeaScratch, IdeaCode, library usage, Adafruit IO, music, ESP-NOW.
